acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec amendment (human acceptance required) defines the producer, its input (Playwright --list --reporter=json) and its canonical output, with failure modes.
The STATIC_UNRESOLVED/onlyInReceipt result on a correctly resolved config is diagnosed with file:line, fixed or explained.
After acceptance: implementation with focused tests and a real Playwright listing qualification.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#709. --playwright-discovery requires a canonical playwright-discovery/0 receipt but no Corvint command produces one; Playwright's own `test --list --reporter=json` output yields discovery.state=MALFORMED. A hand-built receipt (142 project/file units, canonical) was accepted but returned STATIC_UNRESOLVED with all 142 units onlyInReceipt and 0 static, probably downstream of part 1 (no static projects). Expected: a supported producer (e.g. `corvint affected discovery`) and a diagnosis of the onlyInReceipt result.
title: affected: producer for playwright-discovery/0 receipts from a Playwright --list listing, and why a hand-built receipt stays STATIC_UNRESOLVED (GitHub #709 part 2)
